english: First craft and place a Field Crafting Mat from 20 plant fibers and 20 wood. All Delve starter weapons and armor are made there; primitive vanilla gear and field supplies can still be made by hand. Welcome to the Living Border. Gather wood, stone and grass, then craft ANY starter weapon: dagger, cudgel, spear, handwraps, bow, wand, staff or totem, plus a Greenleaf Poultice. No fixed class is chosen. Craft one Heritage Seal if desired. Visit the Wayrest Steward, take Reclaim Wayrest and accept contracts. Character levels award talents and separate attribute points; useful actions raise proficiency. Each skill has two fundamentals at proficiency 10 and three branch entries at 20; each purchase costs one talent and branch entries require both fundamentals.

First craft and place a Field Crafting Mat from 20 plant fibers and 20 wood. All Delve starter weapons and armor are made there; primitive vanilla gear and field supplies can still be made by hand. READ to begin the Forest preparation chain. Gather, choose any starter weapon, establish a refuge, then secure water, food and repairs. Buy optional Crafting Tomes for 500 gold each from vendors, or ask the Wayrest Steward about training. Every restock includes at least three different tome types. All early recipe knowledge is available without random books: train the owning proficiency, gather ingredients and use the listed station. Character level and proficiency are separate. Take Reclaim Wayrest from the Steward: ten returned contracts advance the settlement. Defeating the Ashbound Warden advances the independent champion campaign. The Warden arrives two game-hours before dawn. NPC settlements close during incursions. Prepare your own defenses. Optional Arbor preparation follows the Forest lessons.
Field Crafting Mat

Carpentry 1. A one-metre woven mat for all Delve starter weapons and armor. No add-on slots, fuel or recipe tools. Build by hand from 20 plant fibers and 20 wood. Advanced gear still needs specialist stations.
